{{Quote|This is a consular ship&hellip; we're on a diplomatic mission&hellip;''"<br />"''If this is a consular ship, where is the Ambassador?|[[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], shortly before the latter kills the former|<ref name="ANH" />}}
The '''''Tantive IV''''' {{Pronounced|ˈtæntɪˌvi 'fɔ:r}} was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] in the service of the [[House of Organa/Legends|Royal House of Alderaan]]. The ship was a central player in the events following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the beginning of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

It started life as a CR90 corvette named '''''Star of Alderaan''''', but was renamed in honor of diplomats from [[Tantive IV (planet)|Tantive IV]] who visited [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The ship sported twin [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] turrets and a massive drive block of eleven [[Ion engine/Legends|ion turbine engines]].

==Description==
[[File:AlderaansPromise-TCGEoD.jpg|thumb|left|200px|''Tantive IV'' leaving Alderaan]]
The ''Tantive IV'' housed living quarters, formal dining rooms, conference rooms, and an engine room.

[[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] also had a luxurious stateroom on the highest level of the ship to serve dignitaries and official guests. It was appointed with fine art and expensive furniture, and comprised many rooms. The stateroom acted as a living room with a small round coffee table and two large, red sofas, and was connected to two advanced escape pods.

The blockade runner held eight tiny [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] that could seat up to three people and four [[Laser/Legends|laser]]-armed ones that could hold 12 passengers. Eventually the ship was outfitted with weaponry.

===Internal layout===
The decks were numbered in descending order. There were storage holds above the first deck and below the fourth. Engineering decks were numbered similarly and were abaft the main decks, with [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] suites above and below the highest and lowest decks. Sensor Suite A was above and Sensor Suite B was below. There was access to the Sensor Suites from any level through the engineering decks. The main reactor core stretched across all decks and was abaft the engineering decks. [[Turbolaser/Legends|Turbolaser]] turrets were situated towards the bow. Two were placed above and below the first and fourth decks, respectively, and they could be reached from any deck. The forward gunnery deck was forward of Deck 4, which ended further aft than Decks 2 or 3 and with Deck 1. The aft ends of Decks 1 and 4 ended further forward than the other two as well. [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggling]] compartments were further towards the bow, situated in the hammerhead neck and above the computer control deck, which was above the bridge. The forward hold was under Princess Leia's suite, which was on Deck 3 and under the bridge.<ref name="Rebel">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Commander, tear this ship apart until you've found those plans and bring me the passengers. I want them alive!|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="ANH" />}}
[[File:TantiveIVToydaria-SL.png|thumb|right|250px|The ''Tantive IV'' docked on [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]]]
The ''Tantive IV'' was a [[CR70 corvette/Legends|CR70 corvette]] built by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] sometime before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Blockade of Naboo]]. The ship was ordered by [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Mazicia Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] to serve as a [[Consular ship/Legends|consular vessel]] for [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Agrippa Aldrete/Legends|Aggripa Aldrite]]. It was originally commissioned as the '''''Star of Alderaan''''' under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jeremoch Colton/Legends|Jeremoch Colton]]. While the vessel served the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Alderaan]], Queen Mazicia strategically decided not to afford it a royal status. This was done to allow for the future addition of weaponry and other defensive system, for the Queen had foreseen that her family would be pressed into more dangerous duties in the future. When Bail Organa ascended to the position of [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] and was elected as the Senatorial representative of Alderaan, he changed the ''Star of Alderaan''<nowiki/>'s name to ''Tantive IV'' as a diplomatic tribute to the fourth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Tantive system/Legends|Tantive system]]. [[Tantive IV (planet)|Tantive IV]] was home to the [[Tantive Gallery of Progressive Art|Tantive Gallery of Progressive Arts]], a sister gallery to Alderaan's [[Aldera Museum of Modern Expression]]. The renaming of the ship was preceded by a cultural exchange program of art and artists between these institutions. Some time before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Petty Officer/Legends|Master Petty Officer]] [[Corla Metonae/Legends|Corla Metonae]] supervised an expansive refit of the ''Tantive IV''. The addition of the standard Corellian Engineering Corporation [[Vanguard c20 retrofit suite|"Vanguard c20" retrofit suite]] added considerable armor, sensor capacity, weapons systems, and brought the ship in line with a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90]] designation.<ref name="REF">{{InsiderCite|90|Refresher Reading}}</ref>  

===Clone Wars===
During the galaxywide conflict of the Clone Wars, the planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] was blockaded by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and therefore the people of Ryloth were unable to receive food or medical supplies, and were in need of relief from the Republic. As previous support missions had failed to puncture the blockade, Senator Organa took the ''Tantive IV'' to [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]]. There, he requested that the ruler of the system, King [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]], allow the Republic to use Toydaria as a jumping off point for small Republic relief vessels that, while more likely to get past the blockade due to their size, required a planet for refueling before reaching Ryloth.<ref name="Supply Lines">{{TCW|Supply Lines}}</ref>

Initial requests were denied due to the interference of [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], who claimed that any relief action would ally neutral Toydaria with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and force the Federation to break off trade with Toydaria, else the Trade Federation attract interest from and be attacked by the Separatists. However, the King decided to allow Bail Organa to covertly send all the ships he had brought with him for aid and, with the help of a distraction provided by [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], was successful in assisting the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] people.<ref name="Supply Lines" />

Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the ''Tantive IV'' was present on the neutral planet [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] where Bail Organa attended a [[Confederate–Republic peace conference/Legends|peace conference]] between representatives of the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.<ref name="A Friend in Need">{{TCW|A Friend in Need}}</ref>

It was during an exercise testing the launch of escape pods that ''Tantive IV'' was [[Battle of the Karthakk System|attacked]] by the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] in the [[Karthakk system]]. The corvette successfully evaded the attack, though lost its jettisoned escape pods in the process. It was soon discovered that R2-D2 and C-3PO were aboard one of the pods. Chief Petty Officer Corla Metonae, supervisor of the exercise, was blamed for the loss of the droids. Bail Organa placed high importance on retrieving the droids, and eventually succeeded in returning them to ''Tantive IV''.

===Imperial Period===
During the days of the Empire, Princess Leia Organa used the ship and her position in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] to help the struggling [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], often undertaking secret missions under the guise of Humanitarian work.

[[File:TantiveIV-swemp6.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The ''Tantive IV'' on [[Kattada/Legends|Kattada]]]]
The vessel's final voyage was during [[Operation Skyhook]]: a secret mission to the planet [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]] to obtain the [[Death Star plans/Legends|schematics]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] new battle station, the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|First Death Star]].

While the plans from [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]] were by far the largest part of the plans, two other supplemental sets were also [[Death Star plans delivery|delivered]] to the ''Tantive IV'' from [[AX-235]] by the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] [[Maria (Lambda-class)|''Maria'']]&mdash;one set acquired from [[Danuta]] and another [[Raid on Polis Massa|set stolen]] during the [[Death Star Uprising]]. The original plan was to deliver them to the [[Star Cruiser/Legends|Star Cruiser]] [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']], but the sudden [[Assault on the Tantive IV|appearance]] of the Star Destroyer ''[[Immortal/Legends|Immortal]]'' halted the transfer, and ''Tantive IV'' was forced to flee to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

The [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[U-3PO/Legends|U-3PO]], who served aboard the vessel, was a spy for the Empire. Through the use of a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing device]], he helped the Empire track the ''Tantive'' from Toprawa to Tatooine.<ref name="Black Knight">{{SWRadio|Black Knight, White Princess, and Pawns}}</ref><ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=U-3PO}}</ref>

The second part of the mission was to reach the planet Tatooine, find Obi-Wan Kenobi, and escort him to Alderaan, along with the plans for the Death Star. However, the ship was [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|intercepted]] by the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']] while in orbit over the planet.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> In an effort to avoid destruction, the ''Tantive IV'' signalled its surrender and shut down its main [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]] after it was captured by the ''Devastator''{{'s}} [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> After Imperial troops boarded the ship with a [[TIE/br boarding shuttle]], the ''Tantive IV'' was quickly disabled and captured.<ref name="EP4NOVEL">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref>

[[File:TantiveIVcapture-hd.png|thumb|right|200px|The ''Tantive IV'' is pulled into the [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']]{{'s}} [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]]]]
Despite the valiant efforts of the Alderaanian soldiers on board, the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] quickly overran the ship. In a critical move, Leia Organa was able to pass the Death Star plans to R2-D2 and instruct him to make contact with Obi-Wan Kenobi on the surface of Tatooine, before being captured herself.

Vader personally interrogated Captain Raymus Antilles to find the stolen plans with no success. Before Senator Organa was on the row, she had seen the portable accessway attached to the ''Tantive IV''.<ref name="EP4NOVEL" /> Unable to find the plans on board the ''Tantive IV'', Darth Vader ordered a team of stormtroopers to sweep the planet below to find them. Afterward, the corvette was destroyed and the remaining crew was executed. Imperial [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]], including a falsified report by the survey vessel ''[[Wide-Eyed]]'', would later proclaim that an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] storm caused the destruction of the ''Tantive IV''. The ''Wide-Eyed'' transmitted the ''Tantive IV''<nowiki/>'s fabricated distress signal to the [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]], and then reported visual confirmation of the ''Tantive IV''<nowiki/>'s wreckage and sensor confirmation of the death of all crewmembers sixteen hours later.<ref name="REF" /> 

[[9 ABY/Legends|Nine years later]], after the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|took]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] as its capital, the BoSS casefile on the ''Tantive IV'' was closed once it was discovered that the initial report was a complete fabrication.<ref name="REF" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Blockade_Runner_Sketchbook2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Early concept sketch for a Rebel blockade runner.]]
The ''Tantive IV'' first appeared in the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] of the [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], where a hit on the "principal solar fin" damaged the ship. In the film the final shot went to the sensor array, but was diverted and hit the engine section. The [[Incredible Cross-Sections]] explained that the shot overloaded the starboard shield projector, causing damage in the power generator system, which led to shutting down the reactor. According to ''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]'', the ''Tantive IV'' was disabled by ion cannons.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

[[Star Wars Insider 90|''Star Wars Insider'' 90]] states that the ship was built under the name ''Star of Alderaan'' by order of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Mazicia Organa]] for senator [[Agrippa Aldrete/Legends|Agrippa Aldrete]] as a consular vessel. Since Agrippa Aldrete was senator of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] before the time of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''The Phantom Menace'']], this statement contradicts the former statement, that the ship was built some time before the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

In [[Star Wars Insider 93|''Star Wars Insider'' 93's]] article "[[May The Facts Be With You: Part One|May the Facts Be With You: Part One: #1-50]]," the ''Tantive IV'' was noted as being built with a single white-walled hallway and turn, alongside a redressed ''Millennium Falcon'' hold, filmed from several angles to save money. In addition, the production model for the ''Tantive IV'' was also twice as long as the production model of the ''Devastator''. It was also originally intended to be the ''Millennium Falcon'', although after it was made its own separate ship, it still retained some design cues from the ''Millennium Falcon'', in particular the kidder rungs right below the primary sensor array. The explosion effect was achieved by doing pyrotechnic event filming while the shooting model was held upside down.<ref name="Imperial Boarding Party">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/explore/visualguides/chp03.html|text=Episode IV Visual Guide &mdash; Chapter 3: Imperial Boarding Party}}</ref>

The ''Tantive IV'' was originally portrayed using a plastic model for the filming of ''A New Hope''. The creators of the model placed a miniature pin-up girl poster in the cockpit as a joke. It is not visible in the final film. Later, during the filming of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], a computer-generated model was used, but the two models have many differences in appearance, which ultimately led to identifying the new design as a different ship.

===Retconned appearance in the ''Revenge of the Sith''===
[[File:TantiveIV_CR70.jpg|thumb|right|250px|''Sundered Heart'' as a [[CR70 corvette/Legends|CR70 corvette]].]]
Until [[2010]], official sources stated that the ship in ''A New Hope'' and in ''Revenge of the Sith'' are the same. At the official [http://www.starwars.com/databank/starship/tantiveiv/index.html ''Star Wars'' website], the Rebel blockade runner is specifically shown to appear in Episode III, Episode IV, and Episode VI. Many sources supported this, including ''The Art of Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith'', which states:

:"''...Lucas reveals that [the] first ship seen in the 1977 ''Star Wars''&mdash;the Rebel blockade runner (aka the ''Tantive IV'')&mdash;will reappear in ''Revenge of the Sith''. Within the ship, in addition to reconstructing the familiar corridor through which Darth Vader strides, Lucas requests a new meeting room. He also approves of an idea whereby the ship could be reverse-engineered from its Episode IV Rebel version to an earlier peacetime version of itself.''"&mdash;''The Art of Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith'', page 104

However, the [[July]] [[2005]] issue of [[Wikipedia:Cinefex|''Cinefex'']] magazine quotes [[Rob Coleman]], the animation director on ''Revenge of the Sith'', suggesting the idea of a different vessel in the third prequel:

:"''One of the most fun things about this show was linking the first trilogy to this one, introducing designs that make more of an appearance in ''A New Hope''." The cruiser flown by Bail Organa, for example, is a predecessor to the Rebel blockade runner featured in the first shot of the original ''Star Wars''. "It looks a little bit different, but you can tell it comes from the same factory.''"&mdash;''Cinefex'' #102, page 68

The profile for the CR70 corvette in ''Star Wars Insider'' 90 explained the differences of the two ships to fit in with Coleman's comment by stating that the ''Revenge of the Sith'' version is a CR70 model and the ''A New Hope'' version is the ''Tantive IV'' after an [[Vanguard c20 retrofit suite|extensive refitting]], as a CR90 model.

Another retcon appeared in ''[[Star Wars Blueprints: Rebel Edition]]'', in which the Corellian Corvette seen in Episode III was actually the [[Sundered Heart/Legends|''Sundered Heart'']], from the game ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''. In [[August]] 2010, continuity referee [[Leland Chee]] confirmed that the ships in the two films are not the same.<ref name="Chee">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?messageID=17923716#17923653|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2010-08-07|time=2:30 AM}}</ref>
